classifications.evidence: I have determined that Ukraine has made progress in providing adequate and effective protection of intellectual property rights.

classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutory worker-rights determination concerning Thailand that supports suspension of its GSP treatment; the stated consequence is to take effect six months later.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that Thailand is not taking steps to afford to workers in Thailand internationally recognized worker rights.

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination that specified exports exceeded competitive-need limits, establishing the relevant trade-treatment consequence.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that in 2018 certain beneficiary developing countries exported eligible articles in quantities exceeding the applicable competitive need limitations.

classifications.rationale: The President directly terminates duty-free treatment for the covered articles; implementation follows from this present legal act.
classifications.evidence: I hereby terminate the duty-free treatment for such articles from such beneficiary developing countries.

classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutory determination that a competitive-need limitation should be disregarded for specified articles and countries, thereby establishing their preferential-treatment disposition.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the competitive need limitation provided in section 503(c)(2)(A)(i)(II) of the 1974 Act should be disregarded

classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutorily required national-economic-interest determination supporting competitive-need waivers; this is a present statutory finding rather than an instruction to an agency.

classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutory waiver determination for a covered article and country, with the legal consequence arising from the presidential determination rather than later agency discretion.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the competitive need limitations of section 503(c)(2) of the 1974 Act should be waived

classifications.rationale: The President presently determines to redesignate specified countries as beneficiary developing countries for specified articles, changing their GSP status.
classifications.evidence: I have determined to redesignate certain countries as beneficiary developing countries with respect to certain eligible articles

classifications.rationale: The President determines that the statutory competitive-need limitation does not apply to the specified article and country, presently establishing its exemption.
